name: Tokyo Yamanote Boys Pure Raspberry Disc
original_name: TOKYOヤマノテBOYS PURE RASPBERRY DISC
source: Fandisc of the Yamanote Boys series featuring Momose Ayumu (Honey Milk), Kujou Takumi (Super Mint), and Rudo Jesus (Dark Cherry).
